statement: Pinned xone binds a vendor-specific wired USB interface numbered 0, with subclass 0x47 and protocol 0xd0, when a supported vendor matches. It requires interrupt data endpoints. Its optional interface 1 carries GIP audio through an alternate setting with isochronous IN and OUT endpoints; this is not a USB Audio Class presentation.

applicability.revision: Standard Xbox Series where applicable; xone GIP class path also supports other compatible models
applicability.scope: transport/wired.c:12-29, 389-465, 480-500, 545-570. Host-side binding requirements only; actual Series USB descriptors are not captured.
